response_text:
1. (Currently amended) An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb) __and not comprising a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2)__, [[and ]]a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.

2. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus is a cytopathic BVDV-lb virus.

3. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), [[a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or ]]an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom.

4. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, [[a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or ]]or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof.

6. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen __that is not an inactivated bacterial culture of Leptospira__.

7. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is specific for an organism selected from the group consisting of Actinobacillus, DCO1/3166885.1 ATTORNEY DOCKET NO. 210287-0008-00-US-499134Application No.: NEWPage 4Actinomyces, Bacillus, Bordetella, Brachyspira, Campylobacter, Clostridium, Ehrlichia, Erysipelothrix, Escherichia, Histophilus, [[Leptospira, ]]Listeria, Mannheimia, Moraxella, Mycobacterium, Mycoplasma, Pasteurella, Salmonella, and Streptococcus, or a combination thereof.

8. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated __and is not an inactivated bacterial culture of Leptospira__.

12. (Currently amended) The vaccine of claim [[11]]4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of a least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen __that is not an inactivated bacterial culture of Leptospira__.
